title: Hearty Collard Hash
description: A simple, comforting dish made with collard greens and hash browns, perfect for a cold winter morning.

ingredients.name: Nourishing oil
ingredients.notes: such as olive or avocado oil

ingredients.name: Optional: other desired spices or seasonings

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped collard greens to the skillet and cook until wilted.
Add shredded hash browns to the skillet and stir to combine with collard greens.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot, garnished with desired spices or seasonings.
